title: Wu 2008 Lemma 2.2, Chen's double sieve inequality, with the range of the last sum repaired
abstract: A Lean 4 proof of the combinatorial inequality (2.2) of J. Wu, Chen's double sieve, Goldbach's conjecture and the twin prime problem, 2, Acta Arith. 131 (2008), Lemma 2.2: 4 D_{1,2} >= 3 Y1 + Y2 - Y3 - Y4 + Y5 + Y6 - 2 Y7 - Y8 - Y9 - Y10 - Y11 - error, where the Y_i are Wu's sieve sums over the sequence A = {N - p}. The printed proof drops part of the range of the triple sum produced by Buchstab's identity, so the printed Y11, over p4 < N^{1/2-2 kappa1}/p3, is not justified; this formalization proves the inequality with the full range N^{kappa2} <= p4 < N^{1/2-3 kappa1}, for every N > 1, every pair kappa1, kappa2 meeting Wu's hypotheses, any finite A of integers 0 < a < N coprime to N, and with Wu's O(N^{1-kappa1}) made explicit as 4N/(N^{kappa1}-1) for A = {N - p}. Version 2 adds Lemma 3.1 of R. Li, On Chen's theorem, Goldbach's conjecture and almost prime twins II, which is the same inequality at kappa1 = 1/11.49, kappa2 = 1/6.18 with the same gap, repaired. Lean code written by an AI agent; the statement was checked against the paper by AI reviewers and is offered for human audit.
